market.question: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (HIGH) $100 in April?

assessment.reasoning: WTI is at $94.7 on April 26 after a 13% weekly surge driven by the Strait of Hormuz crisis. Brent hit $106, with an unusually wide $11 WTI-Brent spread. WTI needs +5.6% to reach $100 in 4 remaining trading days. Geopolitical tensions remain elevated but US-Iran diplomatic talks in Pakistan on April 26 created some easing pressure, pulling prices off highs.
data_sources: CNBC: US-Iran talks in Pakistan April 24-26
assessment.key_uncertainty: Diplomatic progress could compress oil prices; remaining 4 trading days with high volatility
